mapper.sql: c.id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit, c.hours, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name as teacher_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT , u.real_name as teacher_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.course_code = #{courseCode}

SELECT c.id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit, c.hours, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, u.real_name as teacher_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.course_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_name, course_code, credit, hours, teacher_id, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{credit}, #{hours}, #{teacherId}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
